items.title: Walter "Furry" Lewis Interview, 1967-05-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever know a guy named Winding Boy who played pool and piano? [INTERVIEWEE] Winding Boy.

ctx.x: Did you ever know a guy named Winding Boy who played pool and piano?
Yeah, he was from out of town. He was from New Orleans. No? I don't know him. Didn't know him. Well, I think our tape is about to run out. Yeah.
